statements: This finalization phase is read-only: no secrets generated, consumed, or transmitted.
Evidence files contain no password, token, API key, Cookie, or Authorization header values (strict scan 0 matches).
Known exposure incidents (DeepSeek key echo WD2-LA; consumer keys echo WD2-MCP) remain on record with rotation paths; per operator authorization rotation is deferred until after submission.
Consumer key-auth values and worker tokens were never copied into this package.
